data.audit_logs: Curiosity Gap | The hook identifies a relevant pain point for solopreneurs but fails to elevate it beyond generic frustration. 'Wasting hours' is an overused phrase that lacks specificity and emotional punch. The absence of concrete numbers or a more vivid description of the lost opportunity dilutes the urgency. While 'but' initiates a curiosity gap, the preceding statement doesn't create enough high-stakes tension to maximize its effect. | Quantify the time or impact immediately. Instead of 'hours,' specify '5-10 hours every week' or '20% of your valuable time.' Reframe 'wasting' into a more impactful loss, such as 'burning through,' 'sacrificing,' or 'missing out on [specific benefit].' Consider starting with a direct question or a shocking statistic related to this time waste, directly linking it to lost income or growth.
